name: collab.presence
title: collab.presence
summary: Set your presence (open document, camera, selection, pointer, activity, following); broadcast rate-limited. Also a heartbeat for your claims.
html:
Set your presence (open document, camera, selection, pointer, activity, following); broadcast rate-limited. Also a heartbeat for your claims.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: collab

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
docThe open document (project path).
cameraThe viewport camera.
selectionSelected entity addresses.
pointerWorld point under the pointer.
activityThe current command or turn and its why.
followingSession handle of the participant whose camera this one follows.
